hobbies.name: Balisong flipping
paragraphs: I enjoy balisong flipping. A balisong, also called a butterfly knife, has two handles that rotate around the blade. Flipping involves learning tricks and connecting those movements into sequences.

hobbies.name: Speedcubing
paragraphs: Speedcubing is solving a Rubik’s Cube as quickly as you can. My fastest solve was 13 seconds, though that was a while ago.
I’ve recently gotten back into it and am practicing to get close to that time again.

hobbies.name: Basketball
paragraphs: I also like playing basketball. It’s another way I enjoy spending time away from my desk.

experience.label: Hardware & technical support
experience.summary: Building custom gaming PCs around each customer's budget, performance goals, and preferences.
points: Designed, built, and optimized custom gaming PCs for 30+ customers, selecting components based on budget, performance, and aesthetics. Used PCPartPicker to research and compare CPUs, GPUs, PSUs, cooling systems, and other components.

Diagnosed and resolved hardware and software failures, including POST errors, boot loops, overheating, memory instability, driver conflicts, system crashes, and blue-screen errors through BIOS/UEFI configuration, component isolation, and stress testing.

experience.label: Teaching & mentorship
experience.summary: Helping students navigate demanding coursework and the next step after high school.
points: Tutored junior AVID students in AP U.S. History, AP English Language and Composition, and Precalculus.
Mentored students on succeeding in future AP courses: English Literature and Composition, Government, Macroeconomics, Calculus AB, Physics 1, and Environmental Science.
Guided students through college applications and scholarships, sharing strategies from personal experience.
Created a college and scholarship guide distributed to every AVID teacher at Santa Maria High School for use with future classes.

experience.label: Engineering leadership
experience.summary: Making engineering tangible through hands-on projects and a welcoming STEM community.
points: Led monthly STEM meetings and 11 hands-on engineering projects, creating technical presentations, organizing competitive activities, and guiding teams through planning, design, testing, and final builds.
Recruited and retained 20+ new members through outreach to underrepresented students, building collaboration, technical and critical thinking, and team design skills.
Collaborated with Cal Poly students to organize STEM workshops and campus visits for local high school students.

experience.organization: UC Santa Barbara · Summer Research Academies
experience.label: Computational social science
experience.summary: Studying relationships between media outlet reputation, political bias among Reddit audiences, and interactions across communities.
points: Co-authored a research paper analyzing the connection between media outlet reputation and political bias among Reddit audiences and their interactions, presenting it at the Capstone Seminar.
Collected and cleaned thousands of Reddit discussion threads and comments from hundreds of news outlets using the Reddit API, Selenium, and Python.

Applied VADER sentiment analysis, correlation analysis, and multiple linear regression to study relationships between media reputation, article tone, political topics, audience responses, and audience interactions with other communities.

projects.name: Sourcecado
projects.headline: Shared contacts, tasks, and workflows that recover safely.
projects.description: A local-first AI application for managing sponsor contacts. I developed shared CRM features, Gmail synchronization, and recovery safeguards for interrupted workflows.

points.title: Share tasks across chats
points.text: Developed CRM features for managing sponsor contacts, with shared tasks across chats, descriptions, due dates, AI suggestions, and urgency labels.

points.title: Preserve Gmail synchronization progress
points.text: Implemented persistent checkpoints, message deduplication, and contact matching to preserve conversation history and recover synchronization progress after failures.

points.title: Resume interrupted work safely
points.text: Built recovery safeguards using saved checkpoints and execution records to identify work that is safe to resume. External actions with unknown outcomes require review before retrying.

architecture.label: React interface connects to FastAPI for CRM workflows, with SQLite for persistent storage.

projects.name: Doodle2Design
projects.headline: From sketches and visual preferences to redesigned web pages.
projects.description: A full-stack application that redesigns websites using user sketches, uploaded images, and visual preferences. The project won second place in a hackathon hosted by Amazon and Google employees.

architecture.label: User sketches, images, and visual preferences guide OpenAI analysis and generation of redesigned web pages.

points.title: Start with user input
points.text: Built a full-stack workflow that translates sketches, uploaded images, and visual preferences into redesigned web pages.

points.title: Guide generation with design references
points.text: Integrated OpenAI models for image analysis and website generation, comparing user inputs with 30 design templates to guide layout, style, and visual consistency.

points.title: Build a consistent mood dataset
points.text: Created a dataset of 50 images annotated with mood labels generated by models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, retaining labels identified by all models.

projects.name: Campus Event Finder
projects.headline: A campus event search tool for students.
projects.description: A full-stack application that helps students discover campus events by date, category, and location, with a Flask REST API and persistent SQLite storage.

points.title: Find the right event
points.text: Search and filter campus events by date, category, and location on campus.

points.title: Build the complete workflow
points.text: Designed REST endpoints for event creation, retrieval, filtering, and deletion, backed by SQLite.

points.title: Protect the boundaries
points.text: Integrated user authentication and input validation to protect accounts and prevent invalid event submissions.

architecture.label: A student filters events in a web interface, backed by a Flask REST API and SQLite storage.
